language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hello, I am Tim.
Hi, I'm Brian and I'm six years old. My family lives on the Canary Islands. We live on the largest island, Tenerife. Today, all of us are going on a fishing trip.
My Dad tells me that people from all over the world come here to catch huge fish. But, we're just going to catch small ones to eat.

Before we go, we have to take some items out of the shed. We do this every three months to prepare for the new season. Here, the weather is warm throughout the year, but not too hot. Can you help me collect the
summer stuff?

I am going to join Brian on his fishing trip. Why don't you come
along too?

Summer is perhaps the most fun season.
But, it's not the only season.
Every year, there are four seasons:
spring, summer, autumn and winter.
Summer is the hottest season. After summer comes autumn. During autumn, all the trees shed their leaves and it becomes colder.
Then comes winter, during which time it freezes, brrrrr! After winter comes spring. Spring is a lovely season and all the plants, flowers and leaves grow back, everything becomes colourful again.
Can you help me finish the following sentences about the four seasons?

helperSimple.text: Each sentence describes what happens during a particular season. Can you identify which season fits the sentence?

outro.text:
That was awesome!
You know so much about the four seasons.
